description: This file is a header for the FastLZ lossless compression library, defining constants and function prototypes for compression and decompression.

methods.name: fastlz_compress
methods.description: Compress a block of data, returning the size of the compressed data.

methods.name: fastlz_decompress
methods.description: Decompress a block of data, returning the size of the decompressed data or 0 on error.

methods.name: fastlz_compress_level
methods.description: Compress data with specified compression level (1 or 2).
